title: What Does Disagreement Mean? A Semantic Identifiability Frontier for Pairwise Preference Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.20450v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pairwise comparison data are a standard supervision signal in preference learning, but disagreement in such data can reflect stable latent heterogeneity, ephemeral stochasticity, or non-binary responses hidden by a forced-choice interface. We study which of these semantic distinctions are identifiable from the feedback channel itself. We introduce a nonparametric latent semantic model with three querywise quantities: aggregate directional preference $\mu_q$, persistent disagreement $\tau_q$, and non-binary mass $\alpha_q$. Under the anonymous binary channel, we prove an exact semantic fiber theorem: $\mu_q$ is point-identified, whereas $(\tau_q, \alpha_q)$ vary over an explicit feasible region compatible with the same binary law. Same-annotator repeats identify $\tau_q$ through a covariance identity, abstention-enabled feedback identifies $\alpha_q$ directly, and together they point-identify the full semantic triple. translated_title: 分歧意味着什么？成对偏好学习的语义可辨识性边界
translated_abstract: 成对比较数据是偏好学习中的标准监督信号，但此类数据中的分歧可能反映稳定的潜在异质性、短暂的随机性，或是被强制选择接口所掩盖的非二元响应。我们研究了这些语义区分中哪些可以从反馈通道本身被辨识出来。我们引入了一个非参数潜在语义模型，包含三个按查询定义的量：聚合方向偏好 $\mu_q$、持续分歧 $\tau_q$，以及非二元质量 $\alpha_q$。在匿名二值通道下，我们证明了一个精确的语义纤维定理：$\mu_q$ 是点可辨识的，而 $(\tau_q, \alpha_q)$ 则在与同一二值分布相容的显式可行域内变化。同一标注者的重复标注可通过协方差恒等式辨识 $\tau_q$，支持弃权的反馈则可直接辨识 $\alpha_q$，两者结合即可点辨识完整的语义三元组。我们还推导了有限……
tldr: 该论文提出包含方向偏好、持续分歧和非二元质量三个量的非参数潜在语义模型，证明在匿名二值反馈通道下分歧的语义含义本质上是不可辨识的，但通过同标注者重复标注与允许弃权的反馈相结合可以完整点辨识这三个语义量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a nonparametric latent semantic model with three querywise quantities—directional preference, persistent disagreement, and non-binary mass—proving that the semantic meaning of disagreement is fundamentally unidentifiable from anonymous binary feedback alone, but becomes point-identified when same-annotator repeats and abstention-enabled feedback are combined.
